import TransposeFollowup.GeneratorConvolutionWalk
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Haar.Basic
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.WithDensity
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.Compact

/-! A concrete Haar smoothing kernel. The radius is the ordinary Frobenius
radius: the sum of four squared entry errors is less than the radius squared.
No small-ball volume asymptotic or flattening estimate is asserted here. -/
namespace TransposeFollowup.RealMobius
open Classical MeasureTheory Set SchwartzMap
open scoped ENNReal
set_option autoImplicit false

instance instGroupLocallyCompactSpace : LocallyCompactSpace Group := by
  have : LocallyCompactSpace (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyCompactSpace (Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ))
  exact (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.isClosedEmbedding_val (n := Fin 2) (R := ℝ)).locallyCompactSpace

def mobiusIdentityDistanceSq (g : Group) : ℝ :=
  (g 0 0 - 1) ^ 2 + (g 0 1) ^ 2 + (g 1 0) ^ 2 + (g 1 1 - 1) ^ 2

def mobiusIdentityBall (η : ℝ) : Set Group := {g | mobiusIdentityDistanceSq g < η ^ 2}

theorem mobiusIdentityDistanceSq_continuous : Continuous mobiusIdentityDistanceSq := by
  unfold mobiusIdentityDistanceSq
  fun_prop

theorem mobiusIdentityBall_isOpen (η : ℝ) : IsOpen (mobiusIdentityBall η) :=
  isOpen_lt mobiusIdentityDistanceSq_continuous continuous_const

theorem one_mem_mobiusIdentityBall {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) : (1 : Group) ∈ mobiusIdentityBall η := by
  simpa [mobiusIdentityBall, mobiusIdentityDistanceSq] using sq_pos_of_pos hη

theorem mobiusIdentityBall_entry_bounds {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) {g : Group}
    (hg : g ∈ mobiusIdentityBall η) :
    |g 0 0 - 1| < η ∧ |g 0 1| < η ∧ |g 1 0| < η ∧ |g 1 1 - 1| < η := by
  change (g 0 0 - 1) ^ 2 + (g 0 1) ^ 2 + (g 1 0) ^ 2 + (g 1 1 - 1) ^ 2 < η ^ 2 at hg
  have h0 := sq_nonneg (g 0 0 - 1)
  have h1 := sq_nonneg (g 0 1)
  have h2 := sq_nonneg (g 1 0)
  have h3 := sq_nonneg (g 1 1 - 1)
  exact ⟨abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (by linarith) hη.le,
    abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (by linarith) hη.le,
    abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (by linarith) hη.le,
    abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (by linarith) hη.le⟩

theorem mobiusIdentityBall_subset_compact_box {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ K : Set Group, IsCompact K ∧ mobiusIdentityBall η ⊆ K := by
  let lo : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun i k => (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) i k - η
  let hi : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun i k => (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) i k + η
  have hc : IsCompact (Icc lo hi) :=
    @isCompact_Icc (Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) _ _ _ lo hi
  refine ⟨(fun g : Group => fun i k : Fin 2 => g i k) ⁻¹' Icc lo hi,
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.isClosedEmbedding_val (n := Fin 2) (R := ℝ)).isCompact_preimage hc, ?_⟩
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨h00, h01, h10, h11⟩ := mobiusIdentityBall_entry_bounds hη hg
  have hentries : ∀ i k : Fin 2, |g i k - (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) i k| < η := by
    intro i k
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases k <;> simpa using (by assumption)
  constructor
  · intro i k
    have h := (abs_lt.mp (hentries i k)).1
    change (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) i k - η ≤ g i k
    linarith
  · intro i k
    have h := (abs_lt.mp (hentries i k)).2
    change g i k ≤ (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) i k + η
    linarith

variable [MeasurableSpace Group] [BorelSpace Group]

theorem mobiusIdentityBall_haar_pos {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    0 < (Measure.haar : Measure Group) (mobiusIdentityBall η) :=
  (mobiusIdentityBall_isOpen η).measure_pos Measure.haar ⟨1, one_mem_mobiusIdentityBall hη⟩

theorem mobiusIdentityBall_haar_lt_top {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    (Measure.haar : Measure Group) (mobiusIdentityBall η) < ∞ := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hsub⟩ := mobiusIdentityBall_subset_compact_box hη
  exact (measure_mono hsub).trans_lt hK.measure_lt_top

noncomputable def mobiusHaarKernel (η : ℝ) : Measure Group :=
  ((Measure.haar : Measure Group) (mobiusIdentityBall η))⁻¹ •
    (Measure.haar : Measure Group).restrict (mobiusIdentityBall η)

theorem mobiusHaarKernel_probability {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (mobiusHaarKernel η) := by
  constructor
  rw [mobiusHaarKernel, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul]
  exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (mobiusIdentityBall_haar_pos hη).ne'
    (mobiusIdentityBall_haar_lt_top hη).ne

theorem mobiusHaarKernel_ae_mem (η : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ g ∂mobiusHaarKernel η, g ∈ mobiusIdentityBall η :=
  Measure.ae_smul_measure (ae_restrict_mem (mobiusIdentityBall_isOpen η).measurableSet) _

theorem mobiusHaarKernel_ae_entry_bounds {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᵐ g ∂mobiusHaarKernel η, |g 0 0 - 1| ≤ η ∧ |g 0 1| ≤ η ∧ |g 1 0| ≤ η :=
  (mobiusHaarKernel_ae_mem η).mono fun _ hg => by
    obtain ⟨h00, h01, h10, _⟩ := mobiusIdentityBall_entry_bounds hη hg
    exact ⟨h00.le, h01.le, h10.le⟩

theorem mobiusHaarKernel_eq_withDensity (η : ℝ) :
    mobiusHaarKernel η = (Measure.haar : Measure Group).withDensity
      ((mobiusIdentityBall η).indicator (fun _ =>
        ((Measure.haar : Measure Group) (mobiusIdentityBall η))⁻¹)) := by
  rw [withDensity_indicator (mobiusIdentityBall_isOpen η).measurableSet,
    withDensity_const]
  rfl

theorem generatorWalk_haar_smoothed_dyadic_norm_lower {c : ℕ} (G : Fin c → Group) (hc : 0 < c)
    (j : ℕ) (u : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (hu : ‖u.toLp 2 volume‖ = 1) {R r η : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hlarge : r ≤ ‖complexAverage G (u.toLp 2 volume)‖)
    (hR : schwartzDyadicRegularityCost j u ≤ R) (hηpos : 0 < η) (hη : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (m : ℕ) (he : 29 * (2 : ℝ) ^ j * Real.sqrt R * η ≤ r ^ (2 ^ m) / 2) :
    r ^ (2 ^ m) / 2 ≤
      ‖groupActionAverage (generatorWalkMeasure G (2 ^ m) ∗ₘ mobiusHaarKernel η)
        (u.toLp 2 volume)‖ := by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (mobiusHaarKernel η) := mobiusHaarKernel_probability hηpos
  exact generatorWalk_smoothed_dyadic_norm_lower G hc _ j u hu hr hlarge hR hη
    (mobiusHaarKernel_ae_entry_bounds hηpos) m he

end TransposeFollowup.RealMobius

import TransposeFollowup.MobiusColumnHaar

/-! A polynomial Haar-volume bound for bounded matrix entries, derived
from the proved column chart rather than assumed coordinate geometry. -/
namespace TransposeFollowup.RealMobius
open Classical MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ENNReal
set_option autoImplicit false

def matrixEntryBox (B : ℝ) : Set Group := {g | ∀ i j : Fin 2, |g i j| ≤ B}

theorem columnShear_abs_le_second_column (g : Group) :
    |columnShear g| ≤ (g 0 1 ^ 2 + g 1 1 ^ 2) / 2 := by
  let d := g 0 0 * g 0 1 + g 1 0 * g 1 1
  let q := columnSqNorm (firstColumn g)
  let r := g 0 1 ^ 2 + g 1 1 ^ 2
  have hq : 0 < q := columnSqNorm_pos (firstColumn_ne_zero g)
  have hgram : q * r - d ^ 2 = 1 := by
    calc
      _ = (g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 * g 1 0) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [q, r, d, columnSqNorm, firstColumn]
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [determinant]; norm_num
  have hd : 2 * |d| ≤ q * r := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|d| - 1), sq_abs d]
  change |d / q| ≤ r / 2
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hq, div_le_iff₀ hq]
  nlinarith only [hd]

theorem matrixEntryBox_column_bounds {B : ℝ} {g : Group} (hg : g ∈ matrixEntryBox B) :
    columnSqNorm (firstColumn g) ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 ∧ |columnShear g| ≤ B ^ 2 := by
  have hs (i j : Fin 2) : g i j ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 :=
    sq_le_sq' (abs_le.mp (hg i j)).1 (abs_le.mp (hg i j)).2
  constructor
  · change g 0 0 ^ 2 + g 1 0 ^ 2 ≤ _
    linarith [hs 0 0, hs 1 0]
  · have hb := columnShear_abs_le_second_column g
    linarith [hs 0 1, hs 1 1]

theorem matrixEntryBox_isCompact (B : ℝ) : IsCompact (matrixEntryBox B) := by
  have hc : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding (fun g : Group => fun i j : Fin 2 => g i j) :=
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.isClosedEmbedding_val (n := Fin 2) (R := ℝ)
  have hi := hc.isCompact_preimage
    (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (fun _ _ : Fin 2 => -B) (fun _ _ : Fin 2 => B)))
  convert hi using 1
  ext g
  simp [matrixEntryBox, abs_le, Pi.le_def, forall_and]

theorem matrixEntryBox_coordinates_subset (B : ℝ) :
    columnCoordinates '' matrixEntryBox B ⊆
      Icc (fun _ : Fin 2 => -B) (fun _ : Fin 2 => B) ×ˢ Icc (-(B ^ 2)) (B ^ 2) := by
  rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  have hb := (matrixEntryBox_column_bounds hg).2
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, abs_le.mp hb⟩
  · intro i
    exact (abs_le.mp (hg i 0)).1
  · intro i
    exact (abs_le.mp (hg i 0)).2

variable [MeasurableSpace Group] [BorelSpace Group]

theorem columnChartMeasure_entryBox_le {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    columnChartMeasure (matrixEntryBox B) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (8 * B ^ 4) := by
  calc
    _ = volume (columnCoordinates '' matrixEntryBox B) :=
      columnChartMeasure_compact _ (matrixEntryBox_isCompact B)
    _ ≤ volume (Icc (fun _ : Fin 2 => -B) (fun _ : Fin 2 => B) ×ˢ Icc (-(B ^ 2)) (B ^ 2)) :=
      measure_mono (matrixEntryBox_coordinates_subset B)
    _ = _ := by
      change ((volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)).prod (volume : Measure ℝ))
        (Icc (fun _ : Fin 2 => -B) (fun _ : Fin 2 => B) ×ˢ Icc (-(B ^ 2)) (B ^ 2)) = _
      rw [Measure.prod_prod, Real.volume_Icc_pi, Real.volume_Icc]
      simp only [Fin.prod_univ_two, sub_neg_eq_add]
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
      congr 1
      ring

theorem haar_entryBox_le {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    (Measure.haar : Measure Group) (matrixEntryBox B) ≤
      (Measure.haarScalarFactor Measure.haar columnChartMeasure : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (8 * B ^ 4) := by
  calc
    _ = (Measure.haarScalarFactor Measure.haar columnChartMeasure : ℝ≥0∞) *
        columnChartMeasure (matrixEntryBox B) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [haar_eq_columnChartMeasure]
      rfl
    _ ≤ _ := by
      gcongr
      exact columnChartMeasure_entryBox_le hB

end TransposeFollowup.RealMobius

import TransposeFollowup.MobiusSmoothedDensity
import TransposeFollowup.MobiusHaarEntryBox

/-! Actual support bounds for symmetric generator walks and Haar smoothing.
These are derived from matrix multiplication, inversion and convolution;
no support or density-flatness estimate is assumed for the walk. -/
namespace TransposeFollowup.RealMobius
open Classical MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ENNReal
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem one_mem_matrixEntryBox : (1 : Group) ∈ matrixEntryBox 1 := by
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num

theorem matrixEntryBox_inv {B : ℝ} {g : Group} (hg : g ∈ matrixEntryBox B) :
    g⁻¹ ∈ matrixEntryBox B := by
  intro i j
  rw [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.SL2_inv_expl]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · exact hg 1 1
  · change |-g 0 1| ≤ B
    simpa only [abs_neg] using hg 0 1
  · change |-g 1 0| ≤ B
    simpa only [abs_neg] using hg 1 0
  · exact hg 0 0

theorem matrixEntryBox_mul {B C : ℝ} {g h : Group}
    (hg : g ∈ matrixEntryBox B) (hh : h ∈ matrixEntryBox C) :
    g * h ∈ matrixEntryBox (2 * B * C) := by
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hg 0 0)
  intro i j
  calc
    _ = |g i 0 * h 0 j + g i 1 * h 1 j| := by
      simp only [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    _ ≤ |g i 0 * h 0 j| + |g i 1 * h 1 j| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = |g i 0| * |h 0 j| + |g i 1| * |h 1 j| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    _ ≤ B * C + B * C := add_le_add
      (mul_le_mul (hg i 0) (hh 0 j) (abs_nonneg _) hB)
      (mul_le_mul (hg i 1) (hh 1 j) (abs_nonneg _) hB)

    obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := abs_lt.mp h11
    constructor <;> linarith
  have h01' : |g 0 1| ≤ 2 := by linarith
  have h10' : |g 1 0| ≤ 2 := by linarith

import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-! Elementary entry bounds and identity neighborhoods of the existing real
Mobius matrix group. These definitions and proofs are shared by trace geometry
and the Haar/walk developments. -/
namespace TransposeFollowup.RealMobius
open Classical Set
set_option autoImplicit false

def mobiusIdentityDistanceSq (g : Group) : ℝ :=
  (g 0 0 - 1) ^ 2 + (g 0 1) ^ 2 + (g 1 0) ^ 2 + (g 1 1 - 1) ^ 2

def mobiusIdentityBall (η : ℝ) : Set Group := {g | mobiusIdentityDistanceSq g < η ^ 2}

theorem mobiusIdentityBall_entry_bounds {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) {g : Group}
    (hg : g ∈ mobiusIdentityBall η) :
    |g 0 0 - 1| < η ∧ |g 0 1| < η ∧ |g 1 0| < η ∧ |g 1 1 - 1| < η := by
  change (g 0 0 - 1) ^ 2 + (g 0 1) ^ 2 + (g 1 0) ^ 2 + (g 1 1 - 1) ^ 2 < η ^ 2 at hg
  have h0 := sq_nonneg (g 0 0 - 1)
  have h1 := sq_nonneg (g 0 1)
  have h2 := sq_nonneg (g 1 0)
  have h3 := sq_nonneg (g 1 1 - 1)
  exact ⟨abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (by linarith) hη.le,
    abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (by linarith) hη.le,
    abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (by linarith) hη.le,
    abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (by linarith) hη.le⟩

def matrixEntryBox (B : ℝ) : Set Group := {g | ∀ i j : Fin 2, |g i j| ≤ B}

theorem one_mem_matrixEntryBox : (1 : Group) ∈ matrixEntryBox 1 := by
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num

theorem matrixEntryBox_inv {B : ℝ} {g : Group} (hg : g ∈ matrixEntryBox B) :
    g⁻¹ ∈ matrixEntryBox B := by
  intro i j
  rw [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.SL2_inv_expl]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · exact hg 1 1
  · change |-g 0 1| ≤ B
    simpa only [abs_neg] using hg 0 1
  · change |-g 1 0| ≤ B
    simpa only [abs_neg] using hg 1 0
  · exact hg 0 0

theorem matrixEntryBox_mul {B C : ℝ} {g h : Group}
    (hg : g ∈ matrixEntryBox B) (hh : h ∈ matrixEntryBox C) :
    g * h ∈ matrixEntryBox (2 * B * C) := by
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hg 0 0)
  intro i j
  calc
    _ = |g i 0 * h 0 j + g i 1 * h 1 j| := by
      simp only [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    _ ≤ |g i 0 * h 0 j| + |g i 1 * h 1 j| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = |g i 0| * |h 0 j| + |g i 1| * |h 1 j| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    _ ≤ B * C + B * C := add_le_add
      (mul_le_mul (hg i 0) (hh 0 j) (abs_nonneg _) hB)
      (mul_le_mul (hg i 1) (hh 1 j) (abs_nonneg _) hB)
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem mobiusIdentityBall_subset_entryBox_two {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hηone : η ≤ 1) :
    mobiusIdentityBall η ⊆ matrixEntryBox 2 := by
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨h00, h01, h10, h11⟩ := mobiusIdentityBall_entry_bounds hη hg
  have h00' : |g 0 0| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := abs_lt.mp h00
    constructor <;> linarith
  have h11' : |g 1 1| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := abs_lt.mp h11
    constructor <;> linarith
  have h01' : |g 0 1| ≤ 2 := by linarith
  have h10' : |g 1 0| ≤ 2 := by linarith
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> assumption

end TransposeFollowup.RealMobius
